visualReview.notes: All 14 current portable frames inspected after correcting the capture far plane for the 5.579km crossing. Completed contractor photographs corrected the first draft to staggered Warren nodes, inclined end posts and short modified pier heads. Overview framing necessarily makes the long narrow crossing small; nine additional cameras inspect its webs, roadway, roof, bearings, floor beams, river piers and end spans.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All 14 current shared-material frames inspected. Canonical painted metal and plain concrete remain consistent across both decks. Open source-local road alignments display without an artificial closing chord. Runtime placement orientation matches the directed source frame; unload passes.

geographicReview.notes: Mapped road axes include a longer southern concrete approach than the replaced steel crossing. Current source separates the steel span extent using the northern terminus and published span schedule. Exact southern abutment and riverbed/floodplain vertical fit remain unresolved.

fidelityReview.notes: Current exterior is 999,896 triangles with true I-sections, gussets, bolts, floor beams, bearings, walkways and lamps. Reviewed against Afcons completed aerial, UMI2022 presentation page28, Dextra engineering article, and mapped aerial ends. Precise truss panel interpretation, pier geometry and levels still require stronger engineering evidence; do not count as complete.
